ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels defining the periphery and central junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs centered on both left and right lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips, with a triangular black intrusion extending from the peduncle into the median notch area. A distinct dark circular pixel cluster is located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe's white region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth relative to lobe peaks of roughly 22%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular serrations. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (1-3 pixels) at distal regions, transitioning to deeper, low-frequency indentations (5-8 pixels) as the contour approaches the medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in an upward convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast textured clusters of brown and pinkish pixels at both distal fluke tips. A single dark circular ring-like anomaly (approx. 5-7 pixel diameter) is isolated on the upper white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced physical protrusions and textured masses (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes; single circular lesion or mark on the upper right lobe white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical colonization of barnacles at the distal points of the fluke lobes.
